response.rationale: The item is a final-sale clearance purchase (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012 at priority 100. This is the highest-priority applicable rule and overrides the standard 30-day window (RET-007). Although within 30 days, final-sale items cannot be returned. The defective exception (RET-020) does not apply because defective is null/not true and it also requires final_sale == False. No goodwill grant or fraud hold facts apply.
